item.tib: ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang tshogs bsgrub pa'i phrin las kyi zin ris pa ku la'i do shal
item.coloph: zhes ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang tshogs bsgrub pa'i phrin las kyi zin ris pa ku la'i do shal 'di nyid mched grogs pradznya pegs ta dang mkhas grub rgya mtsho zung gi dgyes bzhed du sngags rgan 'jigs med gling ming gis go bde nyung bsdus su bgyis pa dge'o
item.note: the text ends with p. 17; the following pages, numbered pp. 18 (fol. 9v), 2, 3, and 4, seem to be loose pages from other texts, although pp. 3-4, giving a musical score, may be a complete text. these pages are followed by three fols. numbered pp. 245-248 and 261-262 which are likewise unconnected with the rest of this volume. pa ku la in the title is probably a tree name, usually spelled ba ku la. on the author, see our text no. 80.49.
